data.description:
BUILDPLAN.md T-09 (M1).

Deploy: Fly app, `popquiz.rustnyc.org` (or fallback host), the short link carrying the code, `smoke`; the skeleton is built with the `dev-host-token` feature, `HOST_DEV_TOKEN` is set as a Fly secret, and the host URL is printed once (`SPEC.md` §8.2, D-19)

Criteria: AC-28, AC-64 (stand-in)
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-05–07
BUILDPLAN notes: Human track: DNS. Serialized on `justfile` (`smoke`). Adds the name `HOST_DEV_TOKEN`, never a value, to `.env.example`

Orchestrator notes: DNS may be absent: BUILDPLAN allows the Fly-provided hostname as fallback. Adds the name `HOST_DEV_TOKEN` to `.env.example`, a file the sandbox cannot read: that one-line edit is made by the Orchestrator outside the sandbox (F-5). The host URL is printed once, to the Orchestrator, never into a log or comment.

HELD: needs H-2 DNS (fallback host allowed) and a Fly deploy. Do not dispatch until the client releases it.

Workflow mode: fast-track. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.
data.title: Deploy to Fly with the host stand-in

data.body: RELEASED by the client 2026-09-26 22:xx ("release PQ-11 with fly's fallback"): H-2 DNS absent, the Fly-provided hostname is the host. Dispatching fast-track off origin/main @ 66a962c (every other M1 ticket merged; #25 canary landed). Worktree …-worktrees/deploy, branch ai-c11-cc/deploy. The Orchestrator appended the HOST_DEV_TOKEN name line to the worktree's .env.example (F-5). Brief carries: --ha=false and no fly launch (PQ-3), main.rs → ws::serve (PQ-6 dev. 4), host URL shape /host?question=q3#<token> (PQ-9), just canary --url as the deployed-room hook (PQ-10 / F-26), the take-it-home link note (PQ-12), the trial org's five-minute machine stop, and the F-2 burst re-run. The host URL is printed once in the tab and nowhere else.
READY PQ-11 CWD /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/deploy HEAD 66a962c47b0eb6c7ec57c1776fb7406846726090 BASE 66a962c47b0eb6c7ec57c1776fb7406846726090 MODE active

PLAN PQ-11 written on the plan file. Two contract tensions, sides taken (deviate-with-flag), for your ruling if you disagree: (1) The exit check wants 'just canary --url <url>' green, but that scan needs the planted canary question on the server, which only T-25's admin push can put there; the skeleton seeds q3 alone. I will run the hook and record its by-design refusal, and smoke carries a q3-based secrecy scan of the deployed room (every frame/response before reveal: no explains, why_tempting, resolving note or check mark; positive control at reveal) — canary_full.rs already says T-09 wires the hook into smoke. (2) ci.yml clearance names the no-feature build, which just test already covers; the build nothing runs is the WITH-feature one, so I add one CI step: cargo test --features dev-host-token,smoke --test standin --test smoke_config --bin smoke. Also: a smoke run releases q3, and the in-memory room refuses a released question until restart, so the deploy chain restarts the app after each smoke run and before the host URL is printed.

PAUSED PQ-11 (client usage limit). Status in_progress. Two signed commits on ai-c11-cc/deploy, HEAD 984e39fccb132a057e415d7faee21ba552ca3c4e, not pushed. Implemented: the dev-host-token stand-in + q3 seed, config.rs, main.rs (PORT, POPQUIZ_PUBLIC_URL, ws::serve), smoke bin + just smoke, Dockerfile/.dockerignore/fly.toml, CI feature step, README Deploying, POPQUIZ_PUBLIC_URL name appended to .env.example. Local: just test-room green 10.3 s warm, test-web green, CI feature step green, smoke green on loopback at 20 and 200 participants (0 leaks). Not done: code review, fly apps create + deploy + secret/smoke/restart chain + host URL print, canary --url record, validation attach, push, PR, review status, DONE.

ORCHESTRATOR ruling on the PLAN tensions (2026-09-27 00:0x): (1) accepted — run 'just canary --url' once, record its by-design refusal (the planted question arrives only with T-25; F-26 already routes that upstream), and let smoke carry the q3-based secrecy scan with the positive control at reveal. (2) accepted — the with-feature CI step is the one that adds coverage. Restart chain accepted: a smoke run releases q3 and the in-memory room refuses a released question until restart, so restart before printing the host URL, and say in the README's Deploying section that 'fly machine restart' resets q3 for another HC-0 drive (the used ledger and lifecycle are T-11's, not yours). RESUME from your PAUSED comment: code review, then the Fly chain (each fly command is the client's approval in your tab), canary --url record, validation attach, push, PR, review status, DONE.

NEEDS HUMAN PQ-11: Fly refuses every command — 'Error: trial has ended, please add a credit card by visiting https://fly.io/trial' (fly apps list, request 01M3GGH6Y0TSSRK8503EX6FJ1K-ewr). The Fly org's card is the client's (out of this ticket's scope), so nothing can be created or deployed until one is added. Meanwhile: code review running on dd6ed99 (README restart line per your ruling added); I will fix its findings and hold before push. On the client's word that the card is in, I go back to in_progress and run the Fly chain.

ORCHESTRATOR ruling (client's word, 2026-09-27 00:1x: 'option 2'): PQ-11 is SPLIT. Your scope is now the code only — the stand-in, q3 seed, config/main.rs, smoke bin + just smoke, Dockerfile/.dockerignore/fly.toml, CI feature step, README, .env.example names. The Fly chain (app create, secret, deploy, deployed smoke, restart, host URL print, canary --url against the deployed room, burst re-run) moved to PQ-33, held until the org has a card. New exit check: (a) code review findings fixed; (b) local smoke green at 20 and 200 (already done — cite the runs); (c) just canary --url against a local stand-in server, its refusal recorded; (d) the README's Running-it stand-in run is now HC-0's path, so make it exact for a desk drive with phones on Wi-Fi: how to bind beyond loopback (PORT → 0.0.0.0 per your config, or say what) and set POPQUIZ_PUBLIC_URL to the laptop's LAN address so join_url, the wall's join line and the QR carry it; the host URL shape; the wall at /wall/{room_id}; that a restart resets q3; (e) validation attached, push, PR against main (body says the deploy moved to PQ-33), lattice status review, DONE with the deploy listed as a deviation. Set yourself back to in_progress and lower your flag now; the Fly blocker is recorded on PQ-33, not on you.
UNBLOCKED PQ-11: the client added a card to the Fly org (spend cap $10). Resuming the Fly chain; code review in flight.

ORCHESTRATOR ruling (2026-09-27 00:4x): the client's in-tab action (card added to the Fly org, spend cap $10) supersedes the 00:1x split. **Full T-09 scope is restored: run the Fly chain as briefed.** Keep from the split ruling the parts that hold regardless: the local 'just canary --url' record and the README's Running-it stand-in run made exact for a desk drive with phones on Wi-Fi (bind beyond loopback, POPQUIZ_PUBLIC_URL = the LAN address, host URL shape, wall path, restart resets q3) — HC-0 may still be driven locally if the trial org's machine stops get in the way. PQ-33 stays open as a placeholder until your deployed smoke is green; the Orchestrator cancels it then. Reminders: one machine, --ha=false, no fly launch; the secret set in one command with the value never in a file, comment or PR; the host URL printed once in this tab only; every fly command asked once with the command visible.

DONE PQ-11 PR https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/26 HEAD 5bab340f8f5e8f86a084ad1a4d2d16ef7878902d BASE 66a962c47b0eb6c7ec57c1776fb7406846726090 test-warm 11.7 (test-room; test-web 192 pass; test-pipeline cannot start here) deviations: (1) just canary --url refuses by design (planted question needs T-25); smoke carries the q3 secrecy scan with a positive control at reveal — ruled accepted. (2) CI gains the WITH-feature step (dev-host-token,smoke: standin, smoke_config, smoke bin), not a no-feature run — ruled accepted. (3) Burst re-run not possible without rework (burst.rs speaks the spike's protocol); substitute is smoke --participants 200 on the deployed room: writes p95 179.5 ms incl. all 200 final writes in one 2 s window, reveal to 200 buzzers p95 53.6 ms, totals exact — smoke's numbers, not burst's AC-53/54/41; HC-0's 'burst green' precondition therefore still waits on T-21. (4) Smoke is its own bin behind a smoke feature (TLS client; dev-deps stay TLS-free); adds optional deps tokio-rustls 0.26 and webpki-roots 1, both already in the lock — Cargo.lock changes only room's own dep list. (5) q3 embedded with include_str!, not POPQUIZ_QUESTIONS_DIR: nothing read at runtime, no unverified file can be pointed at. (6) The binary's take-it-home link is SPEC 13's https://popquiz.rustnyc.org/last (PQ-12's fallback default); the dev Urls::default() '/home' is left for tests and wall fixtures. (7) justfile: besides the smoke recipe, 'smoke:T-09' left PENDING and the header's stale 'Five of them' count was made count-free, so test-full stops listing smoke as pending. (8) Fly and root file placement per the brief: fly.toml, Dockerfile, .dockerignore at repo root (the spike's comments had guessed room/fly.toml). notes: LIVE https://rustnyc-popquiz.fly.dev, one machine 837e23a79e2398 (ewr, shared-cpu-1x 256MB), image 24 MB; host URL printed once in the delegator tab only; restarted after the smoke runs so q3 is fresh. The Fly trial had ended mid-run; the client added a card with a $10 spend cap (one running machine ~$2.32/mo). A smoke run or a real HC-0 drive releases q3 until 'fly apps restart rustnyc-popquiz'. canary_full.rs's refusal text still says T-09's stand-in does not exist yet — stale wording in PQ-10's file, not touched here. Code review PASS-WITH-NITS on dd6ed99 (the dockerignore Critical refuted by the remote build; both Minors fixed in 5bab340, mechanical, not re-reviewed). Spike app untouched.

ORCHESTRATOR (2026-09-27 01:0x): PR #26 verified — head 5bab340 == GitHub == git ls-remote, base 66a962c on main, MERGEABLE, CI in progress; the app answers at https://rustnyc-popquiz.fly.dev. Deviations (1)–(8) accepted as recorded. Two findings for the record: (a) F-2's reading (HC-0's burst evidence = T-03's spike re-run against the deployed skeleton) is not satisfiable without rework because burst.rs speaks the spike's protocol; the deployed smoke at 200 (writes p95 179.5 ms, reveal p95 53.6 ms, totals exact) is the evidence put to the client at HC-0, and the formal AC-53/54/41 run stays T-21's — routed upstream as F-27 (amend HC-0's trigger to name this). (b) canary_full.rs's refusal text still says the T-09 stand-in does not exist — a one-line tidy for PQ-17 (T-25), which next touches the canary. PQ-33 cancelled as moot (deployed smoke green). Merge waits on green CI and the client's word.
